items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: And one of her regular clients was Cole Porter. ... Mr. Cole Porter made his headquarters at Chez Bricktop's.

ctx.x: He was a very, very fine head waiter, and he knew almost everybody, the smart set, because he always worked in the establishments like the Cafe de Paris, and Maxim's and, you see. So, she had everything her way at the time, you see. And one of her regular clients was Cole Porter.
